trust.role: Public ID-token signature verification key. Account policy must independently enroll the exact key and issuer/audience/subject. Entra common keys alone do not authenticate a tenant.
trust.rotationRevocation: Refresh only this fixed official endpoint; review kid/SPKI changes and explicitly update enrolled account policy. Existing key snapshot is not a perpetual trust guarantee.
trust.authentication: Retrieved from an explicitly configured official HTTPS URL using the host trust store; no JWT jku/x5u resolution. JWKS has no intrinsic expiry. Snapshot is provenance, not permanent authorization.

verification.method: Parse official HTTPS JWKS and compute public SPKI fingerprints. This is not a provider credential verification.

provenance.generator: packages/credential-proofs-inputs/src/oidc.ts createSyntheticOidc or packages/credential-proofs-inputs/src/govbr.ts createSyntheticGovbr; public test-only PEM

trust.role: Public repository test key and synthetic ID-token witness only. Never authentic provider-issued evidence.
trust.rotationRevocation: No production use; deterministically regenerate local fixtures.
trust.authentication: Generated with explicitly local public test PEM; production trust policy must not enroll this key.

verification.method: Exact token/witness generated and cryptographically imported through shared verifier; Noir witness evidence linked when available.

acquisitionNotes.reason: No authoritative publicly reusable signed provider-test ID token has been collected. Public JWKS proves key provenance, not token interoperability. Personal capture is optional; local fixtures are explicitly synthetic.
